name: remote-arc
description: Persistent agent runtime that connects ChatGPT to your own computers.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent agent runtime for your computers.
interface.longDescription: Remote Arc gives AI agents a persistent, permissioned runtime across computers you authorize. Pair Windows, macOS, and Linux devices with remotelink, then inspect files, run development commands, create durable tasks and Agent Goals, resume saved work in later chats, and manage execution from the Remote Arc Dashboard.
interface.defaultPrompt: List my Remote Arc devices and persistent tasks, then tell me what is online or needs attention.
